encoding.conditional_law: Self-decoded tape probabilities times inverse interval probabilities cancel to the independent uniform allele prior.

validation.search_law_omitted: MMr omitted as approved; previous non-rejection is not equivalence.

metric_definitions.cost: Evaluations to first full D1331 exact solve, or the cap if unsolved.
metric_definitions.P1: Mean paired log2(T_MG/T_MM), equal cell families/cells within family and equal map families/maps within family.
metric_definitions.P2: Mean paired log2(T_GM/T_MM), equal cell families/cells within family and equal map families/maps within family.
metric_definitions.D: Mean paired log2(T_GG/T_MM), equal cell families/cells within family and equal map families/maps within family.
metric_definitions.I_G: Mean paired log2(T_GG/T_MG), equal cell families/cells within family and equal map families/maps within family.
metric_definitions.O_G: Mean paired log2(T_GG/T_GM), equal cell families/cells within family and equal map families/maps within family.
metric_definitions.interaction: P1 minus O_G in paired log2 cost units.
metric_definitions.S: Per-cell mean log2(T_MG/T_GM) over maps and seeds.
metric_definitions.C: Mean S over four BE cells minus mean S over six PA cells; Welch 95% t over cells.
metric_definitions.pooled_weighting: Equal cell families, equal cells within cell family, equal map families and maps within family

bootstrap.method: Crossed map-within-family / shared whole-seed percentile intervals
bootstrap.weighting: Equal cell families, equal cells within cell family, equal map families and maps within family

outcome.meaning: Validation, coverage or diagonal gain gate failed; no mechanism attribution.
